issue.title: Checkout crashes with KeyError for guest users
issue.body:
Guest users can't complete checkout since this morning. Error page after clicking Pay.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "api/handlers.py", line 88, in post_checkout
    total = pricing.compute_total(cart, user)
  File "checkout/pricing.py", line 41, in compute_total
    currency = user.profile["currency"]
KeyError: 'currency'

issue.title: Report export is very slow
issue.body: Exporting the quarterly PDF report sometimes times out. Workaround: export by month.

issue.title: Can't sign in on Safari
issue.body: After resetting my password, the login page keeps reloading. Session seems lost.
